brief.en: Attacks multiple lanes, one lane at a time

description.en: Dandelions send explosive seeds down three different lanes, one lane at a time.
description.zh: 蒲公英向身前的三行中的一行发射爆炸性蒲公英子弹。

chat.en: "Look," says Dandelion, shaking his head, "I'm not a leprechaun and I'm not a genie. You can blow my seeds off all you want, but I can't make your wish come true. I don't even know how that rumor got started."
chat.zh: “看，”蒲公英摇摇头说，“我才不是什么小妖精或者小精灵。要是想的话，你还可以把我的种子都吹飞，但是我就是不能实现你的愿望。我也不知道这些传闻是谁发起的。”

text.en: can attack targets in the lane above or below
text.zh: 可以打击上下行和本行的目标

text.en: may react to certain strong winds
text.zh: 吹风时有机会作出反应
